scope.summary: Build bounded prerequisite evidence for selecting, invoking, observing, cancelling, reaping, and checking output from FFmpeg and ffprobe on Windows and Unix without a shell, hidden unbounded pipes, or false descendant-containment claims.
in_scope: Define a versioned data-only FFmpeg contract for trusted absolute executable identity, file/version/capability binding, typed operation plans, direct argument vectors, resource limits, deadlines, lifecycle, cancellation, diagnostics, and ffprobe-normalized output facts.

Use direct arguments with explicit stream maps and stream-copy selection; shell construction, arbitrary operator command text, ambient working directories, and unrestricted protocols/input mechanisms are forbidden.

Reserve child stdout for framed -progress pipe:1 evidence in the Phase 0 file-output profile, drain bounded stderr diagnostics separately, send media to a job-scoped file, and never parse human stderr as the progress protocol.
Scrub inherited environment, govern working directory, pass -nostdin, and treat every child-provided byte, path, version string, progress field, diagnostic, and output as untrusted bounded input.

Extend the lifecycle model with Spawned, Running, GracefulStopRequested, ForcedKillRequested, Reaped, and Validated semantics so terminal acceptance remains gated by direct-child reap and output validation.

On Windows, require pre-execution Job assignment, KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE, bounded forced whole-Job termination, direct-child wait, independent ActiveProcesses == 0 query, and sentinel inheritable-handle negatives; report the suspended-orphan residual unless a stronger broker is approved.

On Unix, create a dedicated process group, apply bounded TERM then KILL to the group, wait the direct child, prove absence only for the declared nonescaping fixture topology, execute a setsid escape counterexample, and report that process groups are signal scopes rather than hostile descendant containment.

Prove graceful stop only for declared supported profiles: Unix signal handling and a console-hosted Windows profile if its shared-console constraints are reproducibly met; do not claim general quiet-GUI Windows graceful stop.

Drain progress and stderr concurrently with item, byte, allocation, cadence, parser-work, diagnostic-tail, deadline, and consumer-stall bounds, continuing required drains during cancellation and reap.

Account for FFmpeg process slots, CPU threads, memory, disk I/O, and pipe bytes through existing resource and byte-credit contracts while keeping single-owner leases on their owning supervisor thread.
Validate successful file output through bounded ffprobe JSON facts before commit/archive eligibility and reject crashed, partial, stale, wrong-stream, malformed, or unprobed output.
Run deterministic fake-child cases plus real FFmpeg discovery, stream-copy, progress, cancellation, reaping, and ffprobe validation on pinned Windows and Linux-native identities.

Produce machine-readable reports binding source, host, executable identity, argument-plan hash, lifecycle transitions, limits, direct-child reap, declared containment result, residual uncertainty, output facts, fixture hashes, and timeouts without sensitive path/input disclosure.
non_goals: Shipping a complete post-processing subsystem or claiming broad codec/container compatibility.
Shipping or silently downloading an FFmpeg bundle, installing host packages through product code, or adding an unapproved runtime/native dependency.
Claiming Unix process groups prevent or detect hostile setsid/setpgid escape.
Claiming waitpid or direct-child exit proves arbitrary descendant absence.
Claiming general quiet Windows GUI graceful cancellation before a compatible control-channel mechanism is approved and proven.
Treating exit code, process disappearance, Job close, or fixture labels alone as successful reaping/output evidence.
Claiming product, capability, runtime, packaging, release, or phase progress from this prerequisite spike.

Gate attack: a self-authored report, stale tool identity, missing platform row, or fixture label could impersonate executable reaping and validation evidence.
